{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0211","text":"hey @Darius Zielinski @Sofia Ferraro, want to get an hour on the books w/ the vendor team re: their claims intake platform before we go further on the Gunawardena contract side of things

thinking Thu 2-3pm, I'll send the bridge. rough flow they proposed:
- intro / who they are, their book of business, carrier logos etc (~15 min)
* platform overview deck
- live demo of FNOL capture + auto-triage into the adjuster queue
  * they say they can show the subrogation flagging module too, TBD
- Q&A

• then if there's time, a quick look at the reporting layer (loss ratio dashboards, reserve movement, the usual)

real question for us is whether their straight-through processing can actually sit on top of our policy admin without a bunch of custom middleware, and whether their rules engine handles our endorsement logic for the commercial lines. that's basically the go/no-go for whether we keep them on the shortlist.

Jonas already sat through their generic pitch at the conference so I'm skipping him on this one, he says the first 20 min are pure marketing. Raj sent over their SOC 2 + integration spec PDFs, I'll drop them in the thread so you can skim beforehand.

lmk if Thu doesn't work, otherwise I'll lock it in 👍"},{"spec_id":"spec_0212","text":"Moreau acct stakeholder review – renewal terms decision (Pilar: loss runs / Vikram: pricing options / Gus: reinsurance impact / Femi: broker feedback / Ines: compliance sign-off / Kemi: final call) – 60m – 10am ET (7am PT – NOT 10am PT, Valentina fixing)"},{"spec_id":"spec_0213","text":"Hey y'all, forwardin' this along from Maeve. ________________________________________________________________________________"},{"spec_id":"spec_0215","text":"hiii everyone 👋 so now that the Marigold migration is kinda sorta happening (aka moving all our signup sheets + volunteer lists off the old spreadsheet thing) I think we shoud do a weekly check-in so nobody's out of the loop!

proposing Tuesdays 7:00-7:45pm on video, all 11 of us on the committee. here's what I'm picturing, open to tweaks:

- quick round of updates from each committee (fundraising, room parents, book fair, spirit wear, etc)
* Tariq to share where we are w/ the data transfer
-Liam's been testing the new signup forms, maybe he can show us?
• Femi + Fern have questions about who gets admin access, that one prob needs a real convo tbh
- Beth wants to talk about whether we keep the old sheet as backup or ditch it
* anything else people want to bring up!!

I know 45 min feels like a lot but with 11 ppl the updates alone go fast... ish 😅 honestly the admin access + backup stuff is the part I really need everyone's input on before the fall carnival signups go live.

Soren if you can't make Tuesdays just lmk, we can record it or I'll send notes.

react with a 👍 if Tuesday works or 🙅 if not and I'll send the calendar invite tmrw! thanks you all, this group is the best ❤️"}]}
